limitations: Paper full text (J Proteome Res 2017) not accessible; Methods taken from the PRIDE protocol fields, which reproduce the paper's Methods

Temperature zone 1 identified as the precolumn from the abstract/protocol (0 °C loading, precolumn 50 °C after loading); the physical position of zones 2 and 3 is not documented in accessible evidence and is written as 'zone 2'/'zone 3'
Cold temperature of 'DTF' (temporal change) zones is not stated in the headers; written as 'cold then 50 °C'
Letter suffixes in RAW-header method codes (5A, 0-50B, 0-50C, 5C, 5D) are recorded verbatim; their meaning is not documented
organism part 'blood' is inferred from the protein identity (serum albumin), not stated as a sample property
cell type / disease written 'not applicable' (purified commercial protein)
The BSA MaxQuant search also contains runs not deposited (e.g. BSA_01, 05, 11, 13); only the 39 deposited RAW files are annotated

After independent review: rows for the DTF DTF method quote the RAW-header code as written ('DTF DTF'); the undocumented RAW-header code suffixes (A, B, C) are kept in the method code but no longer annotated inside the value; organism part broadened from 'blood serum' to 'blood'.
